thread:
maria: Quick sync: need final creative for benchmark launch this week. Hero + two detail charts + landing routing tags. Who can take chart CSV?

noah: I got charts. Proposal: hero = compact delta card (p95 latency % vs baseline + $/1k tokens delta). Detail 1 = small-multiples: p95 and median per slice. Detail 2 = stacked cost-per-request by length and quant level.

jamie: Nice. For copy I suggest: "Lower latency, lower token spend — proven on real workloads." Short alt: "Optimize serving, not models." We'll A/B.

oliver: For routing, add signup tags: workload=chat/completion/embedding/rerank and priority=pilot/production. Sales likes that.

cass: Design notes: use brand-blue for baseline, accent-green for our gains, gray for context. Accessibility check for green contrast. design-bot: created frame https://figma.com/file/bench-frames - delta_card_v3.

noah: CSV columns: model, variant, workload_slice, median_ms, p95_ms, cost_per_1k, request_len_bin, quant, throughput. I'll drop sanitized CSV to drive by 3pm.

maria: Webinar script: 1) benchmarks + methodology (5m), 2) demo of routing + fallbacks (12m), 3) customer econ vignette (8m) + Q&A.

jamie: Social snippets ready once we have final headlines. Suggest testing CTA text: "See it in your stack" vs "Run your workload".

maria: Action items: noah - CSV + notes (today 3pm), cass - hero mock (tomorrow AM), jamie - copy variants (tomorrow AM), oliver - routing schema + CRM tags (tomorrow). We'll review in afternoon standup. :white_check_mark:
